topography.project_purpose: Wan Bridge is a cross-chain bridge protocol that enables asset transfers and liquidity provision across multiple blockchains. It supports token bridging, staking, farming, and liquidity pools, with governance and oracle infrastructure to manage cross-chain operations.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Wan Bridge family relies on CrossProxy and CrossDelegateV4 contracts to manage cross-chain message passing and asset transfers, while bVault and various pool contracts handle liquidity and staking. Governance controllers (FarmV2Controller, FarmV3Controller) and reward contracts (NyanRewards, etc.) support farming incentives, and oracle proxies provide price feeds across chains.
